title: Agent harness methodology
summary: How Bouch builds and verifies agent harnesses across domains: durable contracts, progressive knowledge (Skills), capability preference order, domain-native verification, governance, /prime vs recon, and observability of session history. Consult before designing a new harness, Skill, plugin, registry or evaluation approach — the standards research and cross-domain model already exist.

title: Audio and electronic music production
summary: Agent-driven sound design, synthesis, arrangement, mixing and render verification. Bouch has a portable, DAW-independent domain package (bouch-audio: evidence-tiered Skills, references and verification tools) to consult first, a live REAPER workbench controlled through an MCP server (V2), a frozen evidence lab (V1), a researched production-technique corpus, deterministic render analysis, and a cross-source capability map that records which areas are proven and which are still gaps. Human listening is the authority on timbre; analysis proves technical correctness only.

title: Web development
summary: Agent-built web pages verified in a real browser. Bouch has a frozen, qualified reference workbench: a calibrated Playwright capture instrument (screenshots at phone and desktop widths, console and request errors, axe accessibility, layout overflow, silent font fallback) with a project contract that makes the rendered page, not the code, the authority, plus a container reproduction procedure. Consult before building web browser-verification tooling from scratch. A human decides final design quality.

title: Game and 3D asset production
summary: Evidence-led game and 3D asset work: source structure, target-engine import, deterministic runtime checks, real interaction, integrity and candidate lineage, then human visual review. The portable package supplies procedure and close-out tooling; each project owns its engine/DCC adapter, fixtures, runtime harness and visual contract.
